From: Alex Young <alex.young@nimbushealth.com>

Date: Thu, 19 Mar 2026 16:12:00 +0100
Subject: Spring-forward: tri-region demo coverage for week of Mar 29

Hi Grace,

Thanks again for the quick intro call last week. We want to lock a 60–75 minute demo the week of Mar 29 to include folks across London, Boston, and our APAC office (Singapore). We noticed the US spring-forward date lands a week earlier than EU — that creates a tricky 1-hour drift for the overlap day.

Current rough availability from our side:
- London team: Mon/Tue 09:30–12:00 GMT
- Boston team: Mon/Tue 09:00–11:30 EDT
- Singapore team: Tue/Wed 14:00–17:00 SGT

We want to avoid asking the Singapore team to join at 02:00 local time. Is Redwood able to either: (a) split the session into two 40-minute segments for EU/US and APAC, or (b) propose a single slot that lands during reasonable hours for everyone despite the DST offset?

CCing Charlie Long (APAC program lead) who will confirm Singapore windows. We can be flexible but would like to nail a plan this week so we can send calendar invites.

Thanks,
Alex Young
Product Ops — Nimbus Health

Hi Alex — great question and good catch on the DST mismatch.

Short answer: yes, we can accommodate both approaches. Proposal options below after a quick look at the overlap windows (attached a timezone matrix):

Option A — Split sessions (recommended):
- EU/US session (live demo + Q&A): Mon Mar 29 10:30–11:10 EDT / 15:30–16:10 GMT (60m total including Q&A).
- APAC focused session (recorded core + live Q&A): Tue Mar 30 14:00–14:40 SGT (40m).
Benefits: allows focused Q&A with local teams, avoids 02:00 joins for APAC.

Option B — Single session (compromise):
- Tue Mar 30 13:00–14:15 SGT / Tue Mar 30 02:00–03:15 EDT / Tue Mar 30 07:00–08:15 GMT — this is tight and pushes US into early hours on DST-change week, so not ideal.

Operational notes:
- We can split the demo content into a 25–30 minute product walkthrough + 15–20 minute tailored deep dive for each region, then record the EU/US session for APAC to review ahead of the live APAC Q&A.
- I attached a timezone_matrix.csv and a draft calendar invite (demo-invite.ics).

Next steps: if you confirm Option A I’ll send two calendar invites and loop in our APAC Solutions Engineer to run the second session. Vivek — can you own the EU/US session? Mina — can you take the APAC Q&A run?

Best,
Grace O'Connor
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
